name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions in Cindy. When you open a PR, an interactive card helps you submit it and automatically follows CI and reviews until merge. Uses the local GitHub login. Supports github.com.
whenToUse: Use for github.com repositories and links; use GitLab for GitLab instances. Handles issues, PRs, reviews, merges, repositories, Actions, releases, search, and logs. Use the PR card to ask about opening a PR and to show its status afterwards. Uses the local GitHub login or a fallback token.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 117 GitHub operations across issues, pulls, repo, commits, actions, releases, search, users, orgs, events, notifications, gists, git_data, reactions, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitHub operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Repository operations require explicit owner and repo values, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin when working in a repository. API-link fields are removed by default except html_url; set raw=true for the original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Downloads such as Actions artifacts or log ZIPs require a destination directory in the top-level save_dir field of ghost_call.

pr_card.description: Show a PR card in Cindy (not IM). Ask with repo/head/base and optional commits/files; commit/open only after a click or explicit request. Update it with card_id/pr and apply todo; renamed/following report completed actions. Viewing a PR never starts following. Before scheduling, claim_follow=true must succeed with follow_claimed=true. existing_task means another task owns follow-up: show its status and task entry; open-task is navigation only (older clients request a reply link). Delete and verify the schedule before following=false. Refresh by card_id each round; to_latest when notifying. settings.ci_retry_repush is a separate default-off, local plugin-user preference across PRs. Re-read pr_follow_settings each round and before amend/push; missing or unreadable forbids rewriting. Only the pr Skill’s strict conditions permit rewriting an exclusive branch SHA and leased repush, once per PR; never merge authorization.

pr_follow_settings.description: Read the same auto-rename, auto-follow and follow-model preferences used by PR cards. Returns settings without showing a card, creating a task or starting follow-up; preferences are not proof that following is active. Use after opening a PR in IM too, then create and verify follow-up with the pr workflow. A read failure means unknown, not disabled. Returns ci_retry_repush: default-off, shared by this plugin user’s PR follow-ups on this computer only. When enabled, the pr Skill may rewrite an exclusive branch commit SHA and repush under its strict conditions, at most once per PR; no merge authorization. Re-read each round and before amend/push; failed or missing settings forbid rewriting.
